sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Ironball is a game about collecting stars. Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as simple as it seems. Your iron ball is incredibly agile, allowing you to jump, flip, and bounce through levels with ease. However, the presence of square enemies adds an element of unpredictability, forcing you to stay alert and focused. By combining these elements, GamePix has created a game that is both challenging and entertaining.

As you progress through the levels, you'll encounter various obstacles, including moving platforms, spikes, and other hazards. Your goal is to navigate through these obstacles while collecting as many stars as possible. Sounds simple, but the presence of square enemies makes it a whole lot harder. These enemies can consume you, sending you back to the starting point, so you'll need to be quick and agile to avoid them.

One of the things that sets Ironball apart from other arcade games is its use of momentum. Your iron ball has a lot of momentum, which makes it easy to control and maneuver. However, this momentum also makes it difficult to stop or change direction quickly. As a result, you'll need to time your jumps and movements carefully to avoid obstacles and enemies. This adds an element of strategy to the game, as you'll need to plan your movements ahead of time to succeed.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses that can help you on your quest. These include boosts that increase your speed, shields that protect you from enemies, and magnets that attract stars to you. By using these power-ups strategically, you can improve your chances of success and make the game even more challenging.
